b14b4449: What are the words of House Stark?
“Winter Is Coming” is the Starks' perpetual warning: a reminder that hard times always come, even in peacetime.
6497ee48: Who is the Mother of Dragons?
Daenerys Targaryen raises her dragons from the egg and uses them to reconquer the Seven Kingdoms from Essos.
481b0a7b: What is the name of the Starks' ancestral sword?
Ice is the Starks' Valyrian steel greatsword. Tywin Lannister has it melted down after Ned Stark's execution.
d92dcee5: Who becomes king at the end of the series?
Bran Stark is chosen as king at the final council. The Iron Throne itself has been melted by Drogon.
9e0f5111: What is the first name of the Imp, brother of Cersei and Jaime?
Tyrion Lannister is Tywin's youngest son. Nicknamed the Imp, he makes up for his size with a formidable mind.
c976f479: What is the name of Jon Snow's albino direwolf?
Ghost is Jon Snow's albino direwolf. Every Stark child has a direwolf, the symbol of the House.
4a9671e7: Which of Daenerys's dragons is killed and raised by the Night King?
Viserion is killed by the Night King beyond the Wall and raised as an undead dragon breathing icy blue fire.
0af6277e: Who says “Valar Morghulis” to Arya for the first time?
Jaqen H'ghar teaches Arya the words “Valar Morghulis” (“All men must die”) and gives her an iron coin to find him again in Braavos.
c12970d2: Who is Jon Snow's real father?
Rhaegar Targaryen is Jon Snow's father: born Aegon Targaryen, he is the rightful heir to the Iron Throne. His mother is Lyanna Stark.
680b9a64: What is Arya's identity phrase in Braavos?
“A girl has no name” is the phrase of the House of Black and White. Arya must give up her identity to become a Faceless assassin.
51156860: Who was king at the very start of the series?
Robert Baratheon is king at the start, after overthrowing Aerys II. His death sets off the War of the Five Kings.
9a0c46b5: What is the name of Arya Stark's sword?
Needle is Arya's small sword, a gift from Jon Snow. Its light build suits the Braavosi fencing style.
e963f1a4: Casterly Rock is the Lannisters' impregnable fortress on the Sunset Sea, built over a gold mine.
de8588d9: Who kills the Mad King, Aerys II Targaryen?
Jaime Lannister stabs the Mad King in the back to stop him from burning King's Landing, hence his nickname, the Kingslayer.
d07b1f40: What is the seat of power in King's Landing?
The Red Keep towers over King's Landing and houses the Iron Throne, the seat of power of the Seven Kingdoms.
6002264c: What is the continent east of the Narrow Sea called?
Essos is the great eastern continent separated from Westeros by the Narrow Sea, where Daenerys grew up with her brother Viserys.
2091a148: Who unified the Seven Kingdoms with three dragons 300 years ago?
Aegon Targaryen, “the Conqueror”, united the Seven Kingdoms with his three dragons Balerion, Vhagar and Meraxes.
c7b46083: Which character is nicknamed the Hound?
Sandor Clegane is called the Hound for his service to the Lannisters. He has feared fire ever since his brother burned him as a child.
cd3eeebf: Who brings Jon Snow back to life with the magic of the Lord of Light?
Melisandre resurrects Jon Snow. She had believed Stannis was the Lord's chosen one.
fb358e85: What is the name of Jon Snow's Valyrian steel sword?
Longclaw is a Valyrian steel sword with a wolf's-head pommel, given to Jon by Lord Commander Mormont.
1d6fcb9f: What is the name of the mysterious assassin who helps Arya in Braavos?
Jaqen H'ghar is a Faceless Man of Braavos. He teaches Arya the art of changing faces and the philosophy of death.
7cf51379: What is Cersei's fate in the series?
Cersei and Jaime die crushed under the rubble of the Red Keep during Daenerys's attack on King's Landing.
393c1c8c: Gregor Clegane, “the Mountain That Rides”, is the tallest and most brutal knight in Westeros, and Cersei Lannister's enforcer.
06b195a8: How does Robb Stark die in the series?
Robb Stark is murdered at the Red Wedding, arranged by Walder Frey with Roose Bolton in violation of the sacred laws of hospitality.
bbecf05b: Who is Olenna Tyrell, nicknamed the Queen of Thorns?
Olenna is Margaery's sharp-tongued grandmother, one of the cleverest women in Westeros. She arranges Joffrey's death.
79c98f97: What is the name of the king of the White Walkers?
The Night King leads the White Walkers. He was created by the Children of the Forest and can raise the dead.
749d4d53: Who finally kills the Night King?
Arya Stark kills the Night King at the Battle of Winterfell by plunging her Valyrian steel dagger into him: his whole army falls apart.
e1648ac0: Joffrey is poisoned at his wedding feast by Olenna Tyrell, with Petyr Baelish's help. Tyrion is falsely accused.
51a35e19: Tywin Lannister is the father of Tyrion, Cersei and Jaime: the greatest strategist in the Seven Kingdoms and the real power behind the Throne.
022ee657: Petyr Baelish owes his nickname to his family's holding on the Fingers. Master of Coin, he is the court's great manipulator.
f5df7932: Who is the eunuch Master of Whisperers?
Varys is the eunuch who runs the Iron Throne's spy network. He claims to act “for the realm”, but his motives remain ambiguous.
eb57ab7d: What fate awaits Jon Snow in the finale?
Jon Snow heads beyond the Wall with the Free Folk, finally joining the people he had come to sympathize with.
0cf571ae: Where does the Dothraki language spoken in the series come from?
Created by David J. Peterson for HBO
A language of the First Men
The Dothraki language was constructed by David J. Peterson for HBO, with its own grammar, vocabulary and phonology.
79140402: Which American author wrote the fantasy saga A Song of Ice and Fire?
George R.R. Martin wrote A Song of Ice and Fire, which the HBO series adapts. The books are still unfinished.
e465f49a: Which castle is the seat of House Stark?
Winterfell is the Starks' stronghold in the heart of the North, with hot springs and a crypt where the Starks lie.
c6d4908d: Which Hand of the King dies just before the series begins?
Jon Arryn is Hand of the King before the events of the series. His mysterious death sets the main story in motion.
76f64068: Which character does Peter Dinklage play?
Peter Dinklage plays Tyrion Lannister and won 4 Emmy Awards for the role.
84c9a28b: Who is the lord of the Iron Islands at the start of the series?
Balon Greyjoy rules the Iron Islands and is the father of Theon and Yara. Their words: “We Do Not Sow”.
74b82055: House Tyrell rules the Reach, the most fertile region of the Seven Kingdoms. Their castle is Highgarden.
14d35575: Who is Lord Commander of the Night's Watch before Jon Snow?
Jeor Mormont, “the Old Bear”, is Lord Commander. He gives Longclaw to Jon Snow before being murdered by his own men at Craster's Keep.
892988e8: What is the seat of House Tully in the Riverlands?
Riverrun is the Tullys' seat in the heart of the Riverlands, where Robb holds court during the war.
c99474e3: Who is Catelyn Stark's sister, wife of the Lord of the Vale?
Lysa Tully Arryn is Catelyn's sister and Lady of the Vale, an unstable woman who raises her son Robin in the Eyrie.
1540602e: What is the name of Cersei's son who takes his own life after Margaery's death?
Tommen is the gentle, weak young king after Joffrey, manipulated by his mother and his wife Margaery. He throws himself from a window after Margaery's death.
cfc567bb: Which character is nicknamed Ser Piggy?
Samwell Tarly is mocked as “Ser Piggy” at the Night's Watch: a timid young noble who becomes Jon Snow's loyal friend.
e76370db: What is Daenerys's fate in the finale?
Daenerys is stabbed by Jon Snow after burning King's Landing and its people: Jon kills her to protect the realm, at the cost of his own heart.
602d8780: What is the name of Sansa Stark's direwolf?
Lady is Sansa's direwolf. She is killed on Cersei's orders after the incident with Joffrey in season 1, one of the series' first losses.
1e432805: What is the largest number of dragons Daenerys has at once?
Daenerys has 3 dragons: Drogon (black), Rhaegal (green) and Viserion (cream). Viserion dies beyond the Wall, Rhaegal in season 8.
d2c6fa47: What are the eunuch soldiers called whom Daenerys frees and who choose to serve her?
The Unsullied are elite soldiers, trained from childhood by the cities of Essos, whom Daenerys frees and who choose to serve her.
37b1ff15: Who is Bronn and what is his role alongside Tyrion?
A charismatic sellsword who becomes his friend and protector
Bronn is the sly, charismatic sellsword who becomes Tyrion's champion at his trial in the Vale. Their friendship is one of the most beloved duos.
a426109a: What is the name of the impregnable fortress of the Vale of Arryn?
The Eyrie is perched atop the Mountains of the Moon. Almost impregnable, it has a Moon Door used to execute prisoners.
186ee44a: Which family rules Dorne, in the south of Westeros?
House Martell rules Dorne, the hottest and most independent region of Westeros. Prince Oberyn is its charismatic representative.
62840110: What is Theon Greyjoy called after being captured and tortured by the Boltons?
Ramsay Bolton breaks Theon until he answers to the name Reek.
77608fc5: Who executes Ned Stark on King Joffrey's orders?
Ser Ilyn Payne, the mute royal executioner, beheads Ned Stark with his own sword Ice, a shocking scene that sets the tone of the series.
4fbe279f: Which character says “Chaos is a ladder” in the series?
“Chaos isn't a pit. Chaos is a ladder.” Littlefinger's iconic line sums up his philosophy of thriving on political chaos.
9cd53ca6: Who is Nymeria in the novels and the series?
Nymeria is Arya's direwolf. Driven away after the incident with Joffrey, she lives in the wild and leads a huge wolf pack in the Riverlands.
0846ca87: What is the name of Ned Stark's daughter who marries Tyrion?
Sansa Stark is forced to marry Tyrion through a Lannister scheme. Despite the circumstances, Tyrion treats her with respect.
635e7962: What is the Braavosi fencing style Syrio Forel teaches Arya called?
Water dancing is the fluid, fast fencing style of Braavos. Syrio Forel, former First Sword of Braavos, teaches it to Arya.
af0ae3ce: What price must Arya pay to become a Faceless assassin?
To become one of the Faceless Men, Arya must give up any personal identity. But in the end she chooses to remain Arya Stark.
8a8304e9: What is Sansa Stark's fate in the finale?
She becomes Queen in the independent North
Sansa secures the North's independence and is crowned Queen in the North.
916957cd: Who is Melisandre really (her true age)?
Melisandre is very old: without her ruby necklace, she appears as a frail, ancient woman. The ruby keeps her looking young.
1729639a: In which eastern slave city does Daenerys temporarily give up a dragon to obtain the Unsullied?
In Astapor, Daenerys trades Drogon for 8,000 Unsullied, then immediately frees the soldiers and has the masters killed. Meereen is the city where she later settles to learn to rule.
c6eecc9f: Which character does Emilia Clarke play in Game of Thrones?
Emilia Clarke plays Daenerys Targaryen and earned 4 Emmy nominations for the role of the Mother of Dragons.
acb0ad9e: Which castle belongs to the Boltons in the series?
The Dreadfort is the Boltons' seat in the North. Its grim reputation reflects the family's practice of flaying.
